form:FormGroup.label: Name
form:FormGroup.helpText: A name for the policy, unique among tool policies.
A disabled policy is kept, but grants nothing.
Whether the policy covers every user, whatever its members.

form:FormGroup.label: Members
form:FormGroup.helpText: The users and groups the policy covers. A group covers everyone in it.

form:FormGroup.label: Categories
form:FormGroup.helpText: The categories of Stroom's tools the policy grants, in the 'Ask Stroom AI' chat and over MCP. A user gets the tools of every enabled policy that covers them; with none, they get no tools. A policy only narrows: each tool still checks the user's other permissions.

form:FormGroup.label: Access
form:FormGroup.helpText: Whether the policy grants only the tools that cannot change anything (Read-only), or all of them (Read and write).

form:FormGroup.label: Tools granted
form:FormGroup.helpText: The tools the ticked categories grant, with the chosen access.
